$description: Measured evidence ledger. sectionHeights is the wrapper-gate input (R9): every route, 1440x900, boxes attributed per extraction/section-map.json by extraction/measure_sections.mjs. External citations point at the source project next to this folder (../); extraction/verify_all.py checks them when that tree exists and only warns when it does not (self-contained copies).

sectionHeights.source: clone dev server (npm run dev, port 5288). The clone matches live page heights within 2px on all 104 routes x 3 widths (pageHeightParity below), so clone boxes stand in for live boxes at 1440.

wrapperGateWhitelist.reviewedBy: agent attestation (Claude Code design-repo build, 2026-11-03), not a human sign-off
wrapperGateWhitelist.justification: The blog index lists all 50 posts in one auto-fill grid; it is a single listing unit with no internal headings or content boundaries, so splitting it would invent sections that do not exist.

pageHeightParity.note: Page-height parity only (live vs clone document scrollHeight).

sectionParity.interpretation: Real pixel-compare numbers at 1440x900 (threshold 24/255 per channel, gate 0.80 per section). Not measured: 1100 and 390 widths per section, hover/interaction states, and animation timing (motion was verified separately in MOTION_QA.md and the CLONE_SPEC files).

histograms.$description: Computed-style histograms over every visible element of all 104 clone routes at 1440 (text-bearing elements for color/font*). Token evidence.

citations.claim: Global tokens, nav, footer, motion system
Motion corrections (more authoritative than first drafts)

notes.noRatingsOnSource: No section on any route renders review ratings, stars or review-platform badges (checked in the copy corpus and DOM extraction); rating roles exist only for the baseline contract.
